reasons.meaning: Invalid source header, execution declaration or caller-cap shape/value; includes unknown, duplicate, empty, misplaced and imported declarations, bounded-prefix failure and invalid literal representation
reasons.source_location: Original entry or module byte span when the condition has one

reasons.meaning: An explicit per-call cap is larger than the source request, including its omitted-field default
The effective source request or explicit caller reduction exceeds the current host ceiling
A charge makes the shared consumed count exceed its provisional or accepted operation limit
reasons.boundary: Equality succeeds; the next charge is reported as the attempted excess

reasons.meaning: A checkpoint observes elapsed computation time above the provisional or accepted limit measured from the original start
A source 0.7 stage or GLB/0.7 reader lacks the required admitted shared work, supplies conflicting limit/callback adapters, or compiles a different entry revision

report.cancellation: Propagate the original callback exception object; do not relabel it as a budget rejection

unchanged_diagnostics: Earlier source, Agent, numerical, output-limit and destination diagnostics retain their meanings; not every failure of the new path is an execution-budget failure
